title: Lesson 3: Architecture at Organizational Scale
description: The jump from running agents to running a fleet of them. How to design for many agents at once: the orchestration patterns that keep work moving, the governance layer that keeps it safe, and why control replaces heroics as the unit of success.

questions.question: Which statement best reflects the lesson’s guidance?
options: A principal sells capacity, wins through leverage, and turns capability into packaged offers.

A fleet of them is an organization you architect.
